description: Is this on-chain token a trap? Give a contract address (any chain — found automatically) or a name/ticker. Checks: can you sell (honeypot), buy/sell tax, can the dev print or freeze, pool locked/burned, top-10 wallets, linked insider wallets, creator's past honeypots, liquidity pulled, FAKE copies of listed coins (tells the real contract), brand copies; plus health (thin pool, bot volume, sellers leading, sharp drops), its Telegram community, and Asrai's own history if tracked. Returns verdict trap | careful | passed, headline, fails, warns, passes. A name used by several tokens returns `candidates` — ask which one (or pass its address). For a big listed coin the new-token rules are notes, and coin_info / coin_brief give the full analysis. Quote the fails first; never call a token safe beyond 'passed the checks'.
